title: Architect cum Design Coordinator
description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONArchitect cum Design Coordinator

**Department:** Architecture \& Design  
**Designation:** Architect cum Design Coordinator  
**Location:** Chalakudy, Kerala  
**Reporting To:** Management / Project Manager

1\. Role Overview

The Architect cum Design Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating and executing architectural and interior design requirements from the initial planning stage through detailed drawings and project execution. The role involves coordination between the design team, project/site team, clients, consultants, and management to ensure drawings and design decisions are properly communicated and implemented.

2\. Key Responsibilities

* Prepare and coordinate **architectural planning, layouts, working drawings, and detailed drawings**.
* Develop and coordinate **interior design drawings**, including furniture layouts, ceiling plans, flooring layouts, elevations, sections, and details.
* Coordinate architectural and interior drawings with structural, electrical, plumbing, and other services.
* Review drawings for accuracy, dimensions, levels, materials, and site requirements before issuing them for execution.
* Coordinate with the **site and project team** to resolve drawing\-related issues during execution.
* Conduct site visits when required to understand existing conditions and verify measurements.
* Coordinate design changes and revisions based on client, management, and site requirements.
* Ensure that all revised drawings are properly updated, recorded, and communicated to the concerned team.
* Coordinate with 3D visualizers, draftsmen, project coordinators, site supervisors, and other design team members.
* Assist in developing **concepts, design presentations, material selections, and design proposals**.
* Ensure that architectural and interior drawings are practical and suitable for execution.
* Prepare and maintain proper drawing documentation and project files.
* Coordinate with clients and internal teams regarding design requirements, modifications, and approvals.
* Support the project team in resolving design and execution\-related issues.
* Ensure that approved designs and drawings are followed at the site.
* Monitor design progress and ensure drawings are delivered according to project schedules.
* Participate in design meetings and provide technical/design inputs whenever required.
* Maintain proper coordination between **design, production, estimation, procurement, and execution teams**.

3\. Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **Architectural Planning and Interior Design**.
* Proficiency in **AutoCAD** is mandatory.
* Knowledge of **Revit / SketchUp / 3D software** will be an advantage.
* Good understanding of architectural and interior working drawings.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings.
* Good knowledge of materials, finishes, furniture, and construction details.
* Strong coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to identify drawing and site\-related issues and provide practical solutions.
* Good attention to dimensions, details, and accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and drawing requirements simultaneously.

4\. Qualification \& Experience

* Bachelor's degree/diploma in **Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field**.
* Relevant experience in architectural and interior design coordination is preferred.
* Candidates with experience in **residential architecture, interiors, and project execution** will be preferred.

5\. Key Performance Expectations

* Timely completion of architectural and interior drawings.
* Accuracy and quality of drawings.
* Effective coordination between design and execution teams.
* Minimum drawing errors and revisions caused by coordination gaps.
* Proper documentation and control of drawing revisions.
* Timely response to site and project requirements.
* Proper implementation of approved designs at the project site.
* Effective communication with clients, management, and internal teams.
* Ability to work according to project schedules and priorities.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

title: Junior Architect
description:
ARCHITECTURAL CONTENT DESIGNER / SOCIAL MEDIA CREATIVE

Company: National Design Groups (NADG)

Industry: Architecture **Interiors**  Landscape

Location: Kerala

Employment Type: Full\-Time

Probation Salary: ₹18,000/month for the first 2 months

Salary after Probation: Revised based on performance, creative ability and responsibility

ABOUT THE ROLE

National Design Groups (NADG) is looking for a creative Architect or Interior Designer with a strong interest in architectural content, graphic design and social media.

This is not a conventional social media executive position.

We are looking for someone who understands architecture and design well enough to translate our projects, concepts, drawings, materials, site progress and design thinking into high\-quality visual content for NADG's digital platforms.

The person should be capable of understanding the design language of NADG and maintaining a consistent, sophisticated and architecture\-focused visual identity across our social media.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage and develop creative content for NADG's architecture and design social media pages.

Create visually strong Instagram posts, carousels, stories and reel concepts.

Convert architectural projects into meaningful visual stories rather than simply posting project photographs.

Work with architects and designers to understand the concept and design thinking behind each project.

Develop content using:

Architectural renders

Plans and drawings

Concept sketches

Material palettes

Site photographs

Detail drawings

Before/after development

Design\-process documentation

Develop conceptual and editorial\-style architectural posts.

Maintain consistency in typography, layouts, graphics, colours and overall visual language.

Prepare a monthly/weekly content calendar and ensure consistent publishing.

Coordinate with the NADG design team to collect drawings, photographs, renders and project information.

Identify interesting architectural details and stories within ongoing projects that can become content.

Research high\-quality architecture and design studios globally to understand evolving presentation and communication trends.

Help establish a distinctive NADG content language instead of following generic social\-media trends.

Coordinate with photographers, videographers or the existing media team whenever required.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Preferred Qualification:

B.Arch / B.Des / Interior Design / Architecture\-related qualification.

Fresh graduates with exceptional creative ability may apply. Candidates with professional architecture/interior\-design experience are also welcome.

REQUIRED SKILLS

Strong understanding of architecture, interiors, materials and design presentation.

Excellent visual sense and composition.

Good understanding of typography and minimal graphic design.

Ability to understand architectural drawings and renders.

Adobe Photoshop / Illustrator / InDesign or equivalent design software.

Canva or similar content\-design tools.

Basic understanding of Instagram content formats and social\-media communication.

Ability to write or develop short, intelligent architectural captions with the team.

Strong attention to detail.

Knowledge of SketchUp, AutoCAD, rendering software, video editing, Procreate or AI creative tools will be an advantage.

THE PERSON WE WANT

We are looking for someone who can look at an architectural project and ask:

“What is the idea behind this design, and how can we communicate it beautifully?”

We do not want our page to become a collection of random renders, trending reels or repetitive promotional posts.

The objective is to build an architectural page that reflects design thinking, originality, materiality, detailing, process and the character of NADG.

The candidate should therefore have:

Strong creative curiosity

An eye for good architecture

Independent thinking

Willingness to research and experiment

Ability to accept design criticism and improve

Consistency and discipline in content production

PROBATION \& COMPENSATION

First 2 months: ₹18,000/month probation salary.

During the probation period, performance will be evaluated based on:

Quality of creative output

Understanding of NADG's design language

Originality of content ideas

Visual consistency

Content planning and execution

Ability to understand architectural projects

Speed and reliability

Initiative and independent thinking

After successful completion of the probation period, salary will be revised based on demonstrated performance and the level of responsibility the candidate can independently handle.

APPLICATION REQUIREMENT

Applicants should submit:

1\. CV / Resume

2\. Architecture / Interior Design Portfolio

3\. Graphic design or social\-media work, if available

Along with the portfolio, applicants may also share 2–3 architecture or design Instagram pages they admire and briefly explain what they like about their content.

Important

Portfolio quality and creative thinking will be given more importance than years of experience.

We are not looking for someone simply to “manage Instagram.”

We are looking for a designer who can help build the visual voice of NADG.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Draughtsman
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* **Drafting Layouts:** Create detailed construction drawings in AutoCAD, including floor plans, building elevations, cross\-sections, layouts, and structural/interior details.
* **Translating Concepts:** Convert rough hand sketches, verbal instructions, and conceptual designs from architects and designers into accurate digital drawings.
* **Detailing \& Annotation:** Add dimensions, leader callouts, material specifications, levels, notes, and other technical annotations required for proper site execution.
* **Standardized Formatting:** Follow company drawing standards, templates, layer management systems, line weights, symbols, and naming conventions.
* **Drawing Modifications:** Update and revise existing drawing sets based on changes requested by clients, architects, designers, or site engineers.
* **Construction Coordination:** Coordinate with architects, designers, project engineers, and site teams to ensure drawings accurately reflect site requirements.
* **Site Drawings:** Prepare drawings and details required for execution and resolve drawing\-related queries from the site team.
* **Quality Checking:** Review drawings for accuracy, dimensions, alignment, detailing, and completeness before issuing them for approval or execution.
* **Drawing Management:** Maintain organized digital files and drawing revisions for current and completed projects.
* **Archiving:** Maintain an organized filing system of previous drawing versions and project documentation for future reference.

Qualifications

* Diploma in **Civil Engineering / Architecture** or equivalent qualification.
* Minimum **5\+ years of experience in the construction field – Mandatory**.
* Strong proficiency in **AutoCAD**.
* Good understanding of construction drawings, detailing, dimensions, and site execution.
* Knowledge of **3D software** is required/preferred.
* Ability to understand architectural and construction drawings.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good coordination and communication skills.

Required Skills

* AutoCAD – **Mandatory**
* Construction Drawing \& Detailing
* Architectural / Civil Drafting
* Drawing Revision \& Documentation
* Site Coordination
* 3D Software Knowledge
* Understanding of Construction Methods

Candidate Profile

We are looking for a technically skilled Draughtsman who can independently prepare **accurate, detailed, and execution\-ready drawings** and coordinate effectively with the design and project teams.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
